title: Comparison table
description: Switching emails. Exactly 4 rows; keep each cell under 10 words.
usage: Two-column “us vs them” comparison on charcoal. Left = competitor pain, right = Libre benefit. Locked layout — edit only text.
notes: Stays a two-column table on mobile (as in the Mobile frame); cell side padding drops from 16px to 8px.
The 16px column gutter is a fixed spacer cell; Figma narrows it to 8px on mobile.
Row gaps are spacer rows with mfs-pt3 (24px → 16px).
Dark mode inverts: panel goes white, left cells get charcoal text, right cells go charcoal with white text. The #7B8290 border (border/primary) is unchanged.
Heading uses mfs-h2 per CONVENTIONS (28 → 24 on mobile); the Figma Mobile frame keeps 28px.
